findings.title: Public Firebase Client Web API Key Exposed in Client Asset
findings.reproduction: Gitleaks dir /src scan identified Google API key in client bundle.
findings.impact: Minimal (Firebase API keys are designed as public client project identifiers, but should have HTTP referrer restrictions in GCP Console).
findings.remediation: Configure HTTP Referrer restrictions on Google Cloud Platform Console for the Firebase Web API Key.

findings.title: Development Tooling Subdependencies with Known CVEs
findings.impact: Zero impact on production runtime API servers.
findings.remediation: Update devDependencies via `pnpm update` during standard maintenance cycles.

findings.title: Fastify Duplicate Route Declaration on /practice/evaluate
findings.evidence: FST_ERR_DUPLICATED_ROUTE: Method 'POST' already declared for route '/api/practice/evaluate'
findings.reproduction: Starting Fastify API server with both submissionRoutes and problemRoutes enabled.
findings.impact: Server startup failure if both route files attempt to register the exact same endpoint simultaneously.
